default.q: What is the standard pre-money valuation benchmark for early-stage B2B startups?
default.a: Valuations typically range between ₹15Cr to ₹40Cr depending on annual recurring revenue (ARR), founder pedigree, pilot contracts, and gross margin profile.

default.q: How can founders prepare for due diligence before term sheet issuance?
default.a: Ensure your data room includes clean cap tables, verified incorporation documents, audited P&L statements, IP assignment agreements, and customer cohort retention data.
